title: Phase 0: repository foundation (monorepo, docs, ADRs, CI)
body:
**Backlog ID:** `P0-01` · **Phase:** 0

## Description
Establish the monorepo scaffold, documentation set, ADRs, baseline CI and the full backlog (PRD §11 Phase 0, §21).

## Scope
- pnpm workspace: apps/web, apps/api, packages/config, packages/ui
- Docs: README, AGENTS, PRD, ARCHITECTURE, ROADMAP, SECURITY, DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW, DEFINITION_OF_DONE, ADRs 0001–0008
- docker-compose (Postgres, Redis), .env.example
- CI workflow, PR + issue templates
- Out: any product feature

## Dependencies
- None

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `pnpm install && pnpm check` passes
- [ ] CI `verify` passes on the PR
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] Docker dev services start (verify on a machine with Docker)

## Testing requirements
- Trivial-but-real tests per package (env validation, health e2e, i18n, tokens)

## Security considerations
- No default credentials; .env.example placeholders only; pnpm allowBuilds allow-list

_Definition of Done: docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md. Spec: docs/PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md._
